"""Check the first full continuation pass and actual second-pass noise fingerprints."""

import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from v175_postprocess import REPO, ROOT, context, read, ref, source, write_once
from v175_training_trace_audit import validate_trace

from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail

plan, post = context()
output = REPO / "docs/results/v175-first-pass-boundary-audit-v1.json"
assert not output.exists()
owner = read(ROOT / "train-launch-v1.json")["owner"]
process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
assert process.create_time() == owner["created"] and process.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE, psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
raw = (ROOT / "train-trace-v1.jsonl").read_bytes()
prefix = raw[:raw.rfind(b"\n") + 1]
trace = [json.loads(line) for line in prefix.splitlines()]
assert len(trace) >= 1010
event_raw = (ROOT / "train-forward-events-v1.jsonl").read_bytes()
event_prefix = b"".join(line for line in event_raw[:event_raw.rfind(b"\n") + 1].splitlines(keepends=True) if json.loads(line)["step"] <= trace[-1]["step"])
events = [json.loads(line) for line in event_prefix.splitlines()]
cache = read(plan["cache"]["path"])["batches"]
units = read(plan["pair_units"]["path"])["rows"]
eligible = read(plan["clean_sensor_preflight"]["path"])["rows"]
old = read(plan["initial_training"]["path"])["trace"]
audit = validate_trace(trace, cache, units, eligible, old, events, plan)
first, following = trace[0], trace[1000]
assert first["cache_step"] == following["cache_step"] == 1
assert first["original_batch"] == following["original_batch"]
assert first["sensor_draw"]["seed"] != following["sensor_draw"]["seed"]
for key in ["packed", "variance"]:
    assert first["inputs"][key] != following["inputs"][key]
for key in first["inputs"]:
    if key not in ["packed", "variance"]:
        assert first["inputs"][key] == following["inputs"][key]
assert first["parent_values"] != following["parent_values"]
binding = ref(Path(plan["external"]) / "checkpoints/step02000.pt")
checkpoint = torch.load(binding["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
initial = torch.load(plan["initial_checkpoint"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
assert checkpoint["step"] == 2000 and checkpoint["updates"] == 900 and checkpoint["total_updates"] == 1800
assert checkpoint["skipped"] == 100 and checkpoint["counts"] == dict(wrapper=900, frozen=900, network=900, sampler=4500)
assert checkpoint["parent_counts"] == dict(parent=899, DINO=899)
assert len(checkpoint["optimizer"]["state"]) == 141
assert all(float(state["step"]) == 1800 and all(torch.isfinite(value).all() for value in state.values()) for state in checkpoint["optimizer"]["state"].values())
frozen = [key for key in checkpoint["models"] if key.startswith("frozen.")]
assert len(frozen) == 47 and all(torch.equal(checkpoint["models"][key], initial["models"][key]) for key in frozen)
module = LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan["module_config"])
module.load_state_dict(checkpoint["models"], strict=True)
raw_hash = model_hash(module)
module.network.load_state_dict(checkpoint["ema"], strict=True)
EMA_hash = model_hash(module)
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
watch_owner = read(ROOT / "completion-watch-launch-v1.json")["owner"]
watch = psutil.Process(watch_owner["pid"])
assert watch.create_time() == watch_owner["created"] and watch.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE, psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
assert not (ROOT / "train-failure-v1.json").exists() and not (ROOT / "review-launch-v1.json").exists()
write_once(output, dict(status="pass-first-full-continuation-pass-and-distinct-second-pass-noise",
    observed_unix_UTC=time.time(), training_owner=owner, training_owner_live=True, watcher_owner=watch_owner, watcher_live=True,
    checkpoint=binding, checkpoint_new_updates=900, actual_Adam_step=1800, final_Adam_states_in_checkpoint=141,
    checkpoint_fresh_sensor_batches=897, checkpoint_retained_cached_noisy_batches=3, checkpoint_ADC_skips=100,
    checkpoint_matching_calls=900, checkpoint_full_parent_DINO_calls_including_two_replays=899,
    frozen47_state_tensors_exact_initial=True, raw_module_hash=raw_hash, EMA_module_hash=EMA_hash,
    actual_second_pass_first_row=dict(continuation_row=following["continuation_row"], original_batch=following["original_batch"],
        first_seed=first["sensor_draw"]["seed"], second_seed=following["sensor_draw"]["seed"],
        same_target_calibration_and_pairs=True, changed_RAW_fingerprint=True, changed_variance_fingerprint=True,
        recomputed_parent_fingerprint_changed=True),
    live_prefix_rows=len(trace), live_prefix_FP32_loss_totals_checked=audit["totals"], live_prefix_parent_argument_bindings_checked=audit["observed_arguments"],
    journal_prefix=dict(path=str(ROOT / "train-trace-v1.jsonl"), bytes=len(prefix), sha256=hashlib.sha256(prefix).hexdigest()),
    event_journal_prefix=dict(path=str(ROOT / "train-forward-events-v1.jsonl"), bytes=len(event_prefix), sha256=hashlib.sha256(event_prefix).hexdigest()),
    new_neural_forwards=0, new_sensor_noise_draws=0, CUDA_initialized=False, source=source(__file__),
    scope="Actual first-pass checkpoint and a live second-pass journal boundary,not final training or model quality. First and second visits retain the same scene/calibration/target but have distinct actual RAW/variance and newly computed parent fingerprints. Second-pass full arrays were streamed,not retained or independently regenerated. All complete observed prefix rows/events use the shared final validator. Strict tensor loads are CPU-only and no noise or neural forward is repeated."))
print("PASS first900 continuation updates;141 Adam states at1800;distinct second-pass RAW/variance/parent;", len(trace), "live rows;zero extra inference/noise")
